messages:
marta: customer asked for a full playback after an autofallback during canary. Console just shows 'fallback' with no timeline. Can we add a compact playback?

josh: Agreed. Playback should list events: metric trigger, policy eval, decision (auto/human), model switch, and evidence links. Keep each step terse for quick skimming.

rachel: Compliance needs per-account retention settings + redaction. Some customers request 90d unredacted, others require PII removal. We need RBAC + view-audit logs when someone opens playback.

devon: Telemetry plan: emit fallback_audit events indexed by trace_id and span ids. Minimal proto: {"event":"fallback_audit","trace_id":"t-987","time":"2025-05-02T03:12:00Z","from":"redwood-xl","to":"redwood-s","reason":"5xx_spike","operator":"auto","policy":"canary-v3","evidence_ref":"s3://..."}. UI will fetch and stitch spans.

marta: UX: timeline pill in Rollouts tab expands to an inline play bar. Steps are filterable by reason. Show mixed-attribution badge if tokens split across models.

josh: Also add a small 'why' diff button that highlights which policy rules matched at time of decision. Very useful for SRE/customer handoff.

eng-bot: NOTE: default audit retention = 30 days; override via account settings.
